name: ChangE
full_name: Coupled Hot Atom eNsembles to search for liGht dark mattEr
summary: A Chinese hot-atom hybrid-spin system extending the light-dark-matter search bandwidth through different spin-coupling regimes.
detection_principle: Coupled alkali-metal and neon-21 spins measure axion-induced nuclear-spin responses in low-frequency self-compensating and high-frequency hybrid-resonance regimes.

results.summary: Nucleon-coupling limits incorporating dark-matter stochasticity were obtained, improving existing laboratory constraints in some frequency bands.

science_scope: Directly searches for Galactic-halo axions, axionlike particles or other ultralight dark matter. Limits depend on assumed local density, velocity distribution and coupling models; separate scanned mass intervals do not amount to exclusion of the entire range.
